--造石机乌龟接收控制程序（乌龟用）
--By 无节操の节操君

rednet.open("right")
term.clear()
term.setCursorPos(1,1)
term.write("Waiting for order...")
id, msg = rednet.receive(60)

if msg == "s" then
 print("Start process...")
 while msg ~= "t" do
 id, msg = rednet.receive(0.5)
 turtle.dig()
 turtle.digUp()
 turtle.digDown()
 
 if turtle.getItemCount(9) == 64 then
 for i = 1, 30 do
 rednet.broadcast("t")
 sleep(0.1)
 end
 print("Warning! Slot full.")
 msg = "t"
 end
 end
end

print("Process Terminated.")
rednet.close("right")

关于代码的解释：
整个系统运行时，请按照视频中的顺序启动：先启动三台造石机，后启动乌龟，最后启动主控电脑

--造石机主控电脑程序（主控电脑用）
--By 无节操の节操君

term.clear()
term.setCursorPos(1,1)
print("--CobbleStone Generator System--")
rednet.open("right")
rednet.broadcast("s")
print("Process is running now...")
print("Input 't' to terminate the generator")
msg = io.read()

if msg == "t" then--发送终止信息
--间隔0.1秒，总共30次
 for i = 1, 30 do
 rednet.broadcast("t")
 sleep(0.1)
 end
end

term.write("Process Terminated.")
rednet.close("right")
